The two answers name the identical set of 14 closed stores; the engine merely leaves "Contoso Store Delaware" and "Contoso Store New Brunswick" twice each because two successive store records share each name, rather than deduplicating to one name per row as the approved answer does. Both cover the same population (stores carrying a closing date, 'Closed' plus 'Restructured'), so a reader asking for the list of names is served equally by either.
